description: Use this read-only tool before a controlled-opportunity submission when a real productive asset, service, infrastructure, industrial, energy, logistics, software-enabled operating, or other productive-capacity opportunity may fit Quiet Stance but its readiness or rights need checking. It returns a status, missing_inputs, rights assessment, next_step and, only when ready, the submission_tool. It evaluates user-supplied facts only and does not submit data, estimate ROI, claim bankability, create financing or grant authority.

commercial_intent.description: Commercial readiness. No automatic charge; a fixed customer-specific payment request is issued only after scope and price are accepted.

country_location.description: Country and project location or service area.

demand_offtake.description: Existing users, spend, offtake, tariff, contract, capacity demand or other economic use.

estimated_value.description: Optional indicative project value or unknown; this is not independently verified.

owner_authority.description: Owner, host, authority, sponsor or procurement channel that can legitimately authorize action.

project_name.description: Project or asset name used to identify the bounded opportunity.

project_stage.description: Current project stage and the specific next execution or decision step that is blocked.

rights_status.description: Current legitimate route to act. Use unknown when the user cannot establish one; do not upgrade public interest into a mandate.

support_needed.description: Primary missing capability, such as project preparation, co-development, technical delivery, operations or capital.

name: assess_project_opportunity_fit
title: Assess whether a controlled productive opportunity is ready for Quiet Stance review
